description: This file defines the WebSocket connection management infrastructure, including classes for managing WebSocket channels, servers, and message processing, with support for automation integration.

classes.name: WebSocketConnectionManager
classes.description: Manages WebSocket connections, including server and channel classes, message processing, and automation integration.

classes.name: WebSocketConnectionManager::Config
classes.description: Configuration container for WebSocket connection parameters.

classes.name: WebSocketConnectionManager::JSONObjectFactory
classes.description: Factory for creating JSON elements related to WebSocket messages.

classes.name: WebSocketConnectionManager::WebSocketServer
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket server handling message reception, sending, and state changes.

classes.name: WebSocketConnectionManager::WebSocketChannel
classes.description: Manages WebSocket client channels, handling connection establishment and closure.

classes.name: WebSocketConnectionManager::AutomationMessage
classes.description: JSON container for automation messages, including request and response details.

classes.name: WebSocketConnectionManager::ConnectionUpdate
classes.description: JSON container for connection status updates to automation server.

methods.name: WebSocketConnectionManager::SetMessageHandler
methods.description: Sets the callback for handling incoming messages.

methods.name: WebSocketConnectionManager::SetAuthHandler
methods.description: Sets the callback for handling authentication.

methods.name: WebSocketConnectionManager::SetDisconnectHandler
methods.description: Sets the callback for handling disconnections.

methods.name: WebSocketConnectionManager::SetAutomationId
methods.description: Sets the automation server ID for forwarding messages.

methods.name: WebSocketConnectionManager::SendMessageToConnection
methods.description: Sends a JSON-RPC response message to a specific connection.

methods.name: WebSocketConnectionManager::DispatchNotificationToConnection
methods.description: Dispatches a notification message to a specific connection.

methods.name: WebSocketConnectionManager::SendRequestToConnection
methods.description: Sends a request message to a specific connection.

methods.name: WebSocketConnectionManager::UpdateConnection
methods.description: Updates connection status to the automation server.

methods.name: WebSocketConnectionManager::Start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the WebSocket channel using a NodeId.

methods.name: WebSocketConnectionManager::Close
methods.description: Closes a specific connection by connection ID.
